subject: Re: LLP-Bench kickoff - one benchmark for all bag-level learning
body:
Dmitri,

Staffing: Csilla 40% running the method matrix (all nine trainers across the three bag constructions), Freya 30% on results analysis and the metrics dictionaries, Saoirse 50% on infrastructure - she's already stood up the data/bag_ds directory tree with split_0 through split_4 and the results tree for training_dicts and autoint_embeddings.

One real tooling gap: the public benchmark is static, but method reviews will need stress cases - controlled bag-size distributions, noisy proportions, covariate drift. We have no internal tool for this, so we're scoping and building a synthetic-data generation pipeline from scratch - Saoirse owns it end to end at 50%, covering configurable bag construction, label-proportion noise models, and drift injection. First usable version March 27.

Compute: CPU batch tier plus 16 A100s best-effort for the heavier erot_llp runs. No reservation ask.

Bao
